title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.003667193194322 (>9.20391293e-7 over #7631, common U)
body:
## Change

This role-457 derivative gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.003667193194322**, more than **9.20391293 × 10⁻⁷** over the exact paired source-price upper for #7631. It removes paid MOVE 41543, uses the role-242 cancellation and adds one verified INIT/CLEAR lifetime on an existing label. The exact source head is `2f1cc8c0f8c281afd2f99aeeeae6153e269f4721`. The candidate canonical word is `4961e5e9351fa532a51eb8ff2b534bab6acd50cfd35972027cc483810cf635c3`. [Source #7631](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7631) · [Role-457 precedent #7630](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7630).

## Verification

- Exact paired replay compares all 1,501 public rows and verifies the 204 source and 205 candidate CLEAR certificates. The paired native and finite physical checks passed. The 17-call signed invoice reduces paid positions from 110,026 to 110,009, keeps 22,461 productive fields and retains surplus 1,424. The rank changes are paid rank 3 −17, productive rank 9 −17 and productive rank 6 +17. Both pricing engines certify the stated conditional bound. [Pinned signed caller #7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113).
- Both sets of seven signed results passed independent readback. The first worker stopped at the inherited raw precision equality guard. Its distinct measured contexts of 2430 and 2434 are retained. A separate exact certificate checks shared upper context 2434. The guarded continuation passed matched ordinary accounting, all 3,114 candidate maps, 104 main boundaries and assembly. Its independent assessment binds the new observer, worker and output hashes. The complete ordinary bills are 791,355,340 and 791,537,376.
- The archive contains exact words, certificates, matched bills, candidate catalogue and assembly bytes, and public projections linking to the original custody records. The first worker retains its failed verdict and separately observed counters. The continuation has its own passing protected snapshot, final accounting and empty worker group. The portable integrity and price commands check the archived bytes and arithmetic. An independent cold scientific replay remains open.

## Assumptions and review

The application assumes one unimplemented whole-private-extent supplier U for both histories, at the same per-lifetime and per-service tariffs with all width, size and precision factors retained. This includes all admissible rounded residuals, atomic nonaliasing return, the complete 204/205 lifetime bills and the five inherited framework assumptions. The full signed moment at κ = 0.00368 remains negative.

Please review this conditional increase for frontier eligibility at the submitted head. The first review checks are the role-457 equality and CLEAR witnesses, shared upper precision certificate and the complete signed invoice. [Scoped coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19677205).

Credit to DreamingOfClouds for the role-457 and role-242 mechanism, Rohan Arun for the signed caller, SYLforge and the predecessor authors for their retained components, and Clear1nsight for the source lineage and this adaptation with OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT assistance.
